notes.title: An update that causes a delay in the release of the game
notes.notes:
A thrilling juncture awaits Mindless Breakpoint aficionados! Our cherished game is on the brink of a monumental metamorphosis, all thanks to the embrace of a novel game engine. This choice wasn't made lightly; it stems from an enduring commitment to furnish our players with an even more captivating and indelible experience.

https://www.youtube.com/embed/CtDkViLAoFU?si=DYasDOfWWZDLWS5V

[h3]The catalyst for change[/h3]

The transition to a fresh game engine isn't merely about technological progression; it's a response to the trials faced last year. Unity, the former engine for Mindless Breakpoint, fell short of expectations, introducing issues that impacted the trust of our player community.

The decision to switch engines was propelled by the aspiration to restore and surpass the eroded trust. We want to reassure our players that we are toiling ceaselessly to provide them with a stable, reliable, and cutting-edge platform.

➡️ [url=https://d4fgames.com/unity-and-recent-changes-reflecting-on-our-games/]Unity and recent changes: Contemplating Our Gaming Journey[/url]

[h3]A superior gaming odyssey
[/h3]
[url=https://d4fgames.com/unity-and-recent-changes-reflecting-on-our-games/]This shift to a new game engine[/url] is more than a technical imperative; it's a commitment to enhancing our users’ gaming experience. With this cutting-edge engine, we're unlocking doors to broader possibilities, offering advanced visual effects, unprecedented gameplay smoothness, and enriched interactivity.

Understanding your affinity for Mindless Breakpoint, we assure you that this transition is crafted to ensure the game retains its unique allure, now enriched with new features and details that will render the adventure even more immersive.

[url=https://videoapi-muybridge.vimeocdn.com/animated-thumbnails/image/12cda466-489a-45eb-a4db-f3e6b54909e5.gif?ClientID=vimeo-core-prod&Date=1707122132&Signature=33b98285d82a908327f02771b840800ec01857cf][img]https://videoapi-muybridge.vimeocdn.com/animated-thumbnails/image/12cda466-489a-45eb-a4db-f3e6b54909e5.gif?ClientID=vimeo-core-prod&Date=1707122132&Signature=33b98285d82a908327f02771b840800ec01857cf[/img][/url]

[h3]Reliability takes precedence[/h3]

We acknowledge that trust is not easily restored. Yet, we are resolute in rebuilding the trust of our community through openness, transparency, and, most importantly, by delivering a product that mirrors our dedication to providing a high-quality gaming experience.

We invite you to embark on this journey with us. Regular updates, sneak peeks of new features, and exclusive behind-the-scenes glimpses of this thrilling transformation will be shared.

Thank you for your patience, support, and unwavering dedication to Mindless Breakpoint. This marks the commencement of a new chapter, and we eagerly anticipate sharing the adventures that lie ahead with our new game engine.

Stay tuned, stay excited, stay Mindless Breakpoint!

notes.title: Try the demo of Mindless Breakpoint At 6h00PM
notes.notes:
Exciting news! The Steam Next Fest starts today, and we have an amazing treat for you. 🎉
The FREE DEMO of Mindless Breakpoint is now available to play! 

➡️ Steam Page: https://bit.ly/3ZI1lyz

➡️ Works in progress Teaser: https://bit.ly/468oHR8

➡️ Learn More: https://bit.ly/3IDem6k


Immerse yourself in the captivating world of horror and get a taste of the spine-chilling adventure that awaits. Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience the game firsthand. 
Wish list Mindless Breakpoint on Steam and join us in the thrilling journey! 👻

[h2]The appointments[/h2]
Get ready for some gaming fun! We'll be playing Mindless Breakpoint today at 2 PM and 6 PM (or whenever we figure out how to stream on Steam 😄). Join us for an entertaining adventure filled with thrills and surprises. Let's see if we can conquer the game together! Don't forget to tune in and cheer us on! 🎮

[h2]Occasional bugs and glitches[/h2]
Please note that as Mindless Breakpoint is still in development, there may be occasional bugs and glitches. We appreciate your understanding and patience as we work diligently to provide you with the best gaming experience possible. Your feedback and support are invaluable in helping us refine and improve the game. Together, let's make Mindless Breakpoint an horrifying adventure!
